## BAYGUARD / Detailing appointment recovery
Synthetic acceptance lab • Dubai business scenario • no client deployment claimed

**Business rule:** fit the service duration and bay capability before offering a cancellation. One targeted hold, not a broadcast.

No Telegram messages, credentials, personal customer data or payments in this workflow.

## CAPACITY → CONSENT → EXPIRY → ACCEPTANCE
Customer identity must come from the authenticated channel. Only trusted staff/timer events may allocate offers.

**Production gate:** stress-test conditional state persistence; add a durable delivery outbox. This sequential test suite does not prove database-level concurrency.

## EVIDENCE, NOT INVENTED RESULTS
One recovered appointment in synthetic records ≠ a real sale.

Model inputs: 120 appointments × 15% cancellations × 2/3 eligible × 50% filled = 6 expected recoveries.
6 × (AED 350 − AED 100 variable cost) − AED 200 operations = AED 1,300 modeled contribution.
Freed admin time is capacity, not automatically cash savings.
